gfc149pg.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 50.5 cm Wide - Green - 180 cm
gfc149pg.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 50.5 cm Wide - Green - 180 cm
gfc149pg.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree offers a blend of elegant styling and functional design, making it a standout addition to seasonal décor. Its cone-shaped structure encapsulates modern simplicity while its versatility allows seamless incorporation into both indoor and outdoor spaces. Suitable for living rooms or patios, it brings the sparkle of holidays to your ambiance with its built-in LED strip lights that create a warm white glow, enhancing the festive spirit. Materials: This artificial Christmas tree is expertly crafted from premium PVC, which offers exceptional durability and the ability to withstand seasonal use both indoors and outdoors. The high-quality PVC material ensures that the tree maintains its lush appearance through many festive seasons, providing reliability without compromising on its lightweight stature. Included Components: Featuring LED strip lights and USB connectivity, this tree illuminates your festive setting with ease. The LED technology ensures energy-efficient lighting, while the USB plug offers versatility in power sources, allowing you to light up your tree from a computer, a power bank, or any USB-enabled outlet. Features /Function /Design: Its cone-shaped design adds a touch of modern flare, complementing various decorating styles. The tree is ornately decorative, standing as a centerpiece that radiates warmth and joy with its included warm white LEDs, crafting an enchanting atmosphere suited for any celebration. Recommended Uses: Perfect for living rooms or outdoor terraces, this tree adapts to various environments, offering a welcoming glow to gatherings. Its elegant presentation and practical design allow it to function stylishly in multiple settings, providing joyful seasonal charm. Care &Maintenance: To ensure lasting quality, cover the tree when not in use to protect against dust and exposure. Keeping it in a shaded location will prolong its visual appeal, inherited from its durable construction materials. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and plastic and steel Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 50.5 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Lifelike Tips Snow Flocked Number of PVC tips: 286 Number of baubles: 120 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 300 cm Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Foldable stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
